newsitem.title: USA: Delta signs exclusive pact with Boeing.
newsitem.headline: Delta signs exclusive pact with Boeing.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc. said Thursday it signed an exclusive $15 billion supply pact with Boeing Co. that will cover its aircraft acquisition needs for the next 20 to 25 years.

The Atlanta-based carrier said it ordered 106 Boeing aircraft and has options for 124 more in a deal valued at $15 billion. The plan also includes "rolling options" for 414 aircraft, bringing the deal to potentially 644 planes.
Options are guaranteed delivery slots, while rolling options are a pool of aircraft delivery positions that replace options as the options expire or are exercised.
